project.name: fixam
project.repo_layout: single Next.js app (no monorepo for v1)

stack.data_fetching: Server Components for reads; Server Actions for writes; TanStack Query only for client-side live lists that need polling/optimistic updates

database.rls: Enabled on every tenant table; policies written in SQL migrations
database.connection: Supabase pooled connection string for serverless; direct connection for migrations

background_jobs.crons: Inngest scheduled functions (Vercel Cron only as a backup heartbeat)

stack.pwa: Serwist (service worker, offline queue with IndexedDB via idb-keyval)

testing.db: Supabase local (supabase CLI) for integration tests

stack.ci: GitHub Actions: lint, typecheck, unit, build; Playwright against Vercel preview

folder_structure.app/(auth): Login, OTP, invite acceptance, password reset
folder_structure.app/(app)/g/[garageSlug]: Staff app for one garage (dashboard, jobs, vehicles, customers, parts, marketplace, reminders, renewals, invoices, reports, settings)
folder_structure.app/t/[token]: Magic-link pages (tracker, estimate approval, invoice/pay, mileage update, renewal, booking)
folder_structure.app/b/[garageSlug]: Public booking page for a garage
folder_structure.components/brand: Brand components (VehicleHealthCard, StatusPill, Confetti, CarAvatar, EmptyState)
folder_structure.lib/db: Drizzle client, schema (one file per domain), RLS helpers
folder_structure.lib/auth: Session, membership resolution, permission checks (can(user, permission))
folder_structure.lib/domain/<feature>: Pure business logic (pricing, tax, mileage, reminders, instalments, ageing) — fully unit tested
folder_structure.tests/e2e: Playwright specs mapped to acceptance-tests.json ids

environments.local: Supabase local via CLI, Inngest dev server, all providers set to 'mock'
environments.preview: Vercel preview per PR, staging Supabase project, providers in test mode
environments.staging: Pilot dry runs, Paystack test keys, real SMS/WhatsApp to whitelisted numbers only

env_vars.note: Paystack signs with the secret key; keep separate var for clarity

conventions.ids: UUID v7 generated in the app (time-sortable)

naming.ts: camelCase; PascalCase for components and types

conventions.timestamps: created_at, updated_at (timestamptz, default now()), deleted_at for soft delete on business records
conventions.document_numbers: Per garage, per branch, per document type, gapless sequence held in document_sequences table and incremented in the same transaction: e.g. INV-{BRANCHCODE}-{000123}, RCT-, EST-, PO-, JOB-
conventions.errors: Server Actions return { ok: true, data } | { ok: false, error: { code, message, fieldErrors? } }; never throw raw errors to the client
conventions.phone_numbers: Store in E.164 (+233XXXXXXXXX); accept local format 0XXXXXXXXX and normalise
conventions.plate_numbers: Store uppercase with single spaces/hyphen normalised, e.g. GR 1234-24; search ignores spaces and hyphens
